measurements.reason: thresholds not frozen (V-002/V-003 pending); this tool reports measurements only

boundaries.initStartAt: decoder-client init start (__journey.initStartAt, before the Worker is created)
boundaries.sourceWait: sourceWaitMs = validInputStartAt - initReadyAt (capture/recording start, picker included)
boundaries.validInputStart: the first frame from the selected source accepted by the session (state -> Receiving; for a recording, the first frame actually presented)
boundaries.initTotal: initMs = validInputStartAt - initStartAt (decoder init + source wait)
boundaries.reconstruction: reconstructMs = reconstructionDoneAt - validInputStartAt: fountain decode + decompress
boundaries.saveRequestAt: SaveController 'selecting' fired (__journey.saveRequestAt) - the save click moment
boundaries.createWritableAccessedAt: the save handle's createWritable getter was accessed (picker resolved)
boundaries.writableAt: createWritable() promise settled (the writable stream exists)
boundaries.writeCloseAt: 'saved' event: write() and close() both resolved
boundaries.pickerWait: pickerWaitMs = createWritableAccessedAt - saveRequestAt (the user picks a path)
boundaries.saveWait: saveWaitMs = writableAt - saveRequestAt (picker + open, NO write)
boundaries.saveWrite: saveWriteMs = writeCloseAt - writableAt (the actual write + close)
boundaries.save: saveMs = writeCloseAt - saveRequestAt (whole save = saveWait + saveWrite)

budget 16777216 (build-desktop-recv/staging/receiver/config/profile.json); rejection then stop then hash-clean normal-file recovery

legs.basis: code-level basis: the receiver has no early artifact-size check. build_artifact (web/desktop-recv/worker/decoder-worker.js:209-246) runs only after the fountain decoder reports a complete file, so an incompressible 20 MiB payload must transfer the full ~20 MiB encoded stream before rejection - unbounded wall time on this rig. The artifact-budget boundary itself is covered by IAT/UT-023 and by the compressible 20 MiB leg, which exercises the real 15008 rejection. The pixel budget is a different (frame-size) boundary and is explicitly NOT a substitute.
